info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Central Cash Handling Management API
info.description: The Central Cash Handling Management API allows businesses to efficiently manage adjustments and updates to cash handling processes. This endpoint is designed for modifying existing cash handling configurations or records, making it essential for finance teams who need to ensure accurate and timely updates. Typical consumers include banking and financial institutions that require real-time cash management capabilities. By providing streamlined operations for altering cash handling parameters, the API supports enhanced financial oversight and operational efficiency.

patch.description: This endpoint allows developers to update the details of a specific central cash handling resource identified by the unique resource ID. Providing accurate and updated information is crucial for maintaining transaction accuracy and compliance.
